weapon.arc_projector.desc: One crack, five enemies light up. Ignores armor, tears wards. Overheats.
weapon.pistol.desc: Slow, exact, never the wrong choice.
weapon.scattergun.desc: Fires only at 9 m: silent while they walk in, brutal at the cage. Shoves light enemies back.
weapon.assault_rifle.desc: A steady thump. Each round passes into a second enemy.
weapon.hornet_rack.desc: A salvo fans out: six targets, six small blasts, a long pause.
weapon.lmg.desc: Spins up to a roar. Strays hit neighbours and fuel drums. Strips armor. Long reload.
weapon.slag_mortar.desc: Lobs at the densest group. Leaves a burning pool that slows.
weapon.cutting_torch.desc: A beam that grows stronger the longer it stays on one target. Overheats.
weapon.rail_lance.desc: A one-second charge line, then everything on the line is hit.

boss.brood_carrier.attack: Opens its hatches every 6 s and releases 6 motes. At half HP it molts and releases faster.
boss.brood_carrier.answer: Area and chain weapons. A stun resets the hatch timer. The molt is a damage window.
boss.lance_platform.attack: Plants 14 m from the core. Charges for 3 s, then a beam hits the core for 160.
boss.lance_platform.answer: EMP during the charge cancels the shot. Burst it while the vents are open.
boss.aegis_array.attack: Pylons orbit it and cut its damage taken to a fifth. With all down it is exposed for 10 s, then redeploys fewer.
boss.aegis_array.answer: Pylons first. EMP drops all pylon protection for 3 s.
boss.tremor_rig.attack: Stomps every 10 s: turrets offline for 4 s and your magazine emptied. Opens breaches at 66% and 33% HP.
boss.tremor_rig.answer: A Shield active at the stomp negates it. Heat weapons ignore the magazine dump.
boss.siege_hulk.attack: Takes three slots at the core and shoves the rest aside. Below 25% HP it attacks 30% faster.
boss.siege_hulk.answer: Armor 12. The Arc Projector ignores armor, and piercing directives strip it.
boss.hulk_plated.attack: Armor 24. Sheds plating at 66% and 33% HP and speeds up each time.
boss.hulk_plated.answer: Piercing, the torch and the rail lance. Hit it hard while the plates are off.
boss.hulk_fed.attack: Two reclaimers escort it and are re-sent every 20 s. It heals 1% of its HP each second while one lives.
boss.hulk_overclocked.attack: Every 12 s: a 1.5 s wind-up, then a 3 s charge at triple speed.
boss.hulk_overclocked.answer: EMP during the charge stops it and stuns it for 2 s.
lore.threat.mote: Hand-sized. Burns out on the cage. Counted in hundreds.
lore.threat.burster: Carries a charge. Goes off where it dies, or where it arrives.
lore.threat.spitter: Stands off and lobs slag at the core.
lore.threat.splitter: One frame, three shards. Break it far from the cage.
lore.threat.shieldbearer: Its ward covers what walks beside it. A pulse drops the ward.
lore.threat.reclaimer: Repairs what you damage. Kill it first.
lore.threat.jammer: Slows your turrets and your triggers while it stands.
lore.threat.borer: Comes up through the yard floor. Watch for cracks.
